author: China Insights
description:
Just months ago, South Korea had the world's hottest stock market.

Now, millions of investors have seen their savings disappear.

Fueled by AI optimism, leveraged ETFs, margin trading, and government-backed market enthusiasm, Korea's record-breaking rally quickly turned into one of the most devastating stock market crashes in recent history.

In this episode, we explain how the bubble formed, why it burst so violently, and why ordinary investors paid the highest price.

#SouthKorea #StockMarket #KOSPI #ETF #AI #Investing #Finance #MarketCrash #Economy #ChinaInsights
title: South Korea's Stock Market Just Collapsed—Millions Lost Everything Overnight
